_comment: check-citations.py config. A pin is [citing doc, cited path, regex the cited line must match, what it is evidence of]. Add a pin whenever a doc cites a line as proof that a rule is enforced.
_scanned: There is deliberately no 'scanned' key here. Setting it FREEZES the scanned set at whatever the plugin shipped on the day you adopted it, which is how one project ended up scanning seven files and finding nothing while its docs lived elsewhere. Omit the key and you follow the plugin's defaults (the instruction files, docs/**, specs/**, agents and skills), which widen as the plugin learns. Add the key only to scan somewhere the defaults do not reach, and then list the defaults too.
_allow_empty: false makes a run that finds zero citations exit 1 — right for a project that means to keep citations honest, because the same zero appears when the scan has drifted off the docs. Leave it true while the project genuinely cites no line numbers.
